fieldValues.title: I-95 and I-96 omit conditional-forbidden: which properties must a conditional-forbidden rule not supply?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: Checked 2026-11-09 at srs 1461d01. RFC-040 Change F added the CrossFieldRule kind conditional-forbidden: docs/schema/2.0/type.json lists four kinds and srs-rust accepts and evaluates it. Invariant 95 (srs/records/invariants/invariant-095.json) still lists only conditional-required, field-ordering and mutual-exclusion, so read literally it makes the engine non-conformant for accepting the fourth kind. Invariant 96 has no 'MUST NOT supply' row for conditional-forbidden, and srs-rust skips the check for it (srs-core validation/record_type.rs, ConditionalForbidden => continue), so a fieldIds list on such a rule is not refused. No issue tracks the invariant text (srs searches find only the closed RFC-040 train #479, #273, #484).
fieldValues.tensions: Option A: an RFC-019 revision (Door 3) that adds conditional-forbidden to I-95 and gives it the same I-96 row as conditional-required (must not supply fieldIds), then srs-rust refuses it. Option B: the same revision with a different property set for conditional-forbidden. Option C: treat RFC-040 Change F as already amending I-95 and only re-render the invariant. Spec, schema and tool drifting apart (SP-01) pulls toward A or C; Continuity pulls toward the smallest change that makes the text true.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: 1. Is the I-95 list an RFC-019 surface (Door 3) or an RFC-040 fold miss that a re-fold fixes (Door 1)? 2. Which properties must conditional-forbidden not supply? Evidence that would choose: RFC-040 Change F's own text and its integration manifest.
fieldValues.blocking: An srs-rust conformance fix for I-96 on conditional-forbidden, and a conformant reading of I-95.
fieldValues.next_action: Owner: choose A, B or C. Recommendation: C if RFC-040 Change F states the kind's properties, else A.
